comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper opening stop versus function-test an emergency stop, reset, and separate restart control.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires concentric driver-and-wrench countertorque that preserves an angular setting; this task requires pushing, twisting, and pressing separate machine controls.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks retained 90° opening across three released cycles; this task checks latched stopping, non-restart after release, deliberate restart, and final clearance.
comparison.reason: Functional verification is shared only generically; the adjusted locknut mechanism and tested manipulation ability are different.
